concatenate: I have my family.  I have the Guru Granth Sahib

concatenate.yes: .  For a while, I thought these might not be enough but… I am allowing myself to hope
concatenate.no: .  I have these things, but I do not have peace.  No one here does

concatenate.yes: .  Still, we have so much work to do to make a home here.
concatenate.no: .  We are crowded, we are plagued by the sounds and the memories of the dead.  The situation is grim.
